end.summary:
Recognised and named halves, thirds and quarters in shapes: 4 of 5 unaided responses were correct.
Explained that the denominator shows the total number of equal parts.
Identified one quarter from four equal sections.
Answered 1/3 of 9 as 3 drumsticks after grouping into three equal groups.
Teach-back was not passed; collection-fraction practice was 0 of 1 unaided correct.
end.parentNote: Asha practised finding equal shares, naming halves, thirds and quarters, and grouping collections to find a fraction. Nisha used the method of counting equal groups and explaining what the denominator represents. There was an early mix-up between 1/3 and 1/2, which was corrected later when they identified one third and one quarter from equal sections (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, draw shapes or groups of objects in equal parts and ask, “What fraction is one part?”
